aria: Animated recap of the Pistons' 122 to 109 road win over the Pelicans: Javonte Green's 3-pointer with 6:16 left in the first half that broke a 46 to 46 tie for a lead Detroit never gave up, quarter-by-quarter scoring, John Collins' 20 points, the top scorers, how the Pistons won, and the next game.

notes: Box score from the Pistons' 122–109 road win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Nov 18, 2026, from the Covers box score, checked line by line against the SI box score and play-by-play, with game details from the Associated Press (via TSN), the Detroit Free Press (via Yahoo Sports) and Ball Exclusives (via Yardbarker). All 122 Detroit points and all 109 New Orleans points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (31–36–25–30 to 31–29–26–23) add up to both totals: 67–60 Detroit at the half (Free Press). Team totals (threes 17 of 32 to 11 of 28, fast-break points 22–9, assists 29–23, field goals 41 of 77 to 37 of 81, points in the paint 48–52) are from the Covers box score; the shooting totals match the AP. Detroit's biggest lead, 19 (117–98 with 5:17 left), is from the box score, the SI play-by-play and Ball Exclusives; New Orleans' biggest lead, 5, is from the box score. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Wednesday's games.

Cade Cunningham (knee soreness) did not play on the second night of a back-to-back, and Duncan Robinson (quadriceps strain) missed his second straight game (AP; Free Press). Seven Pistons scored in double figures (AP). Javonte Green started in Cunningham's place and scored 13 of his 18 in the first half (Free Press). Isaiah Joe returned from a 10-game absence with a bruised hip and scored 11 on 3-of-5 from three (AP; Free Press); his two late third-quarter threes pushed the lead to 90–80 (Free Press; SI play-by-play, 1:38 left in the third). Detroit has won five of six and went 3–1 on its road trip, after beating San Antonio 105–93 on Tuesday (AP). Detroit hosts Toronto on Friday, Nov 20 at 7:30 PM ET (Ball Exclusives).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Javonte Green's 3-pointer with 6:16 left in the first half that made it 49–46; Detroit led the rest of the way (AP). The SI play-by-play lists it as a three-point jump shot assisted by Daniss Jenkins, after two Zion Williamson free throws had tied it 46–46 at 6:26, and it started an 11–2 Detroit run to 57–48 (Free Press; SI play-by-play), so the board shows tied to Pistons +3. The written accounts don't describe the move, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc; the spot and the defender are not drawn to exact positions. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Detroit Pistons or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Javonte Green's listed 6-foot-5 and 205 pounds (RealGM; Wikipedia) with No. 31 (Wikipedia); no wingspan from a named measurement was found, so his arms use the default length. He is drawn in Detroit's road colors with the default figure look (no approved look yet). It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
